review.scope: Independent final synthesis audit of the complete five target artifacts and five audit reports, with targeted inspection of already saved original-paper texts only.
review.summary: The final literature synthesis and prospective comparison pass this source-text audit. All eight research identities and the manuscript publication boundary are correct. No concrete overclaim, false local efficacy, broad novelty claim, or native construction claim remains. The Metaⁿ method wording and two source locators were corrected during review and verified against saved text.
